The total amount of video memory in bytes.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
Print "Video memory: " + (TotalVidMem() / 1048576) + " MB"
WaitKey
```
@returns The size of the video memory in bytes.
@gap The answer comes from the graphics card and is cut off at 2 GB because it has to fit into an integer. It is 0 when no graphics window is open.
